description: An eight channel mixer into three buses, with a clock that walks a cursor over the channels so that the ones inside the step range are heard only as the cursor reaches them

params.text: Steps through the four ways of walking the range: up, down, up and down, and random
Sends the cursor to the first step of the range, or to the last step when the mode is counting down
Starts and stops the stepping, one press running and the next stopped; with it stopped every channel is mixed in continuously
Sets the first channel of the stepped range
Sets the last channel of the stepped range
Sets the internal clock rate, doubling every volt of its setting, from 0.25Hz to 64Hz
Sets the level of that bus output
Sends that channel to bus A, B or C
Silences that channel, one press off and the next on; the lamp is lit while the channel is silenced
Sets the level of that channel

inputs.text: A rising edge steps the cursor to the next channel; with nothing patched here the internal clock runs instead
A rising edge sends the cursor to the first step of the range, or to the last step when the mode is counting down
Scales that channel, 10V leaving it at the slider setting and 0V silencing it

outputs.text: Bus A, carrying the channels whose selector sends them there
Bus B, carrying the channels whose selector sends them there
Bus C, carrying the channels whose selector sends them there

notes: channels outside the range set by the two step knobs are mixed in continuously, while the channels inside it are heard only while the cursor is on them

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
